hardRules: Use at least one primary source.
Do not cover a story already present in history or the current story file.
Do not publish rumours, leaks, predictions, or unverified benchmark claims.
Prefer concrete product, model, developer-tool, research, infrastructure, and major company announcements.
Exclude routine partnerships, minor enterprise customer announcements, and vague executive commentary unless there is a substantial technical development.
Explain what changed, why it matters, and any material limitation.
Do not exaggerate the source or introduce claims the source does not support.
Use clear language for a technical but broad audience.
